artworks.title: Rays of the Sun
artworks.description: This drawing features a mirror in a barren landscape reflecting sunlight. There is a large sun in the upper left corner shining light towards the mirror, which is placed on a small rise in the terrain. The mirror is oval-shaped and reflects the sunlight. The landscape is simple, with outlines suggesting waves or rolling fields, a plant with flowers near the mirror, and faint outlines of distant structures or rocks in the background. The drawing uses delicate linework to depict the interaction between natural elements and man-made objects.

artworks.title: Man Washing a Pearl
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a figure pouring liquid from a jug into a shallow dish. The landscape features hills, buildings, and sparse vegetation. The drawing style consists of crisp lines and stippling in black on an off-white background.

artworks.title: Lioness and Cub Pursued by Hunters
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with hills, trees, two running dogs, a wooden fence, and three figures in pursuit. The horizon is above center, with hills and trees. The dogs are in dynamic poses, with one closer and larger. The wooden fence separates the dogs from the figures. The background has hills and trees with light brushstrokes. The color palette is mainly black ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Dolphins and Crocodile
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sea creatures in water. The scene shows several mythical creatures with serpent-like bodies and dragon-like heads in a coastal environment. The creatures are in various poses in the water, some submerged and others emerging. Delicate lines depict the waves and sky. The composition is balanced, with water taking up most of the space and land and sky framing the scene. The drawing uses minimal details and clean lines, giving it a mythical feel.

artworks.title: Sheep Calling Lamb
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated point of view. The horizon line is near the top, featuring distant hills and a small structure on a hill. In the foreground, a dog is walking on a textured area with bushy trees. The intricate brushstrokes create detailed textures in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The Huntress
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a woman standing at the center, holding a staff and a distaff. Dogs are shown in motion nearby, with a fence running horizontally in front of them. Beyond the fence, sheep are grazing in a landscape of rolling hills with trees. In the distance, there are hills or small mountains under a cloudy sky. The illustration is detailed with cross-hatching and fine lines, giving it a monochromatic appearance in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Doe Mourning her Foal
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with two animals, potentially wolves or dogs, one sitting and the other lying down in a natural setting. The background shows rolling hills with trees, including two tall slender trees and one extending branches to the upper right. The artwork features intricate line work for texture and depth, using cross-hatching for shading. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on line quality and composition. The landscape extends with rounded bushes and sloping hills beyond the animals, creating a tranquil countryside setting.

artworks.title: Lioness Mourning her Cub
artworks.description: The image shows a dog with its mouth open and tongue out, sitting on the ground. Beside the dog, there is a smaller animal. In the background, there are simple lines and curves representing hills and shrubs. A tree is lightly sketched to the right. The scene is presented in a linear style with delicate brushstrokes, using a monochromatic color palette of black, grey, and cream.

artworks.title: Turtle Dove Flying in the Desert
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a landscape with the horizon placed just above the central horizontal line. A bird is flying in the sky, and to the left is a tree with bare branches. The brushstrokes are consistent and linear, creating a monochromatic black-and-white color palette. Rolling hills and trees are depicted in the distance, with a smooth transition from detailed elements in the foreground to softer shapes in the background.

artworks.title: Noah's Ark
artworks.description: The image show a wooden boat on stylized waves, with a horizon line at the lower middle. The water and boat are depicted using simple line strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown. A bird with a branch flies in the top-left corner, and there are clouds and rays of light in the sky above.

artworks.title: Man Cutting a Balm-Tree
artworks.description: The image features a man tending to a small tree in a stylized landscape. The horizon is low with mountains in the distance, and some structures are visible in the background. The artwork is created with fine lines, resembling etching or ink drawing. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. The man is depicted caring for the tree, surrounded by sparse vegetation, with taller trees framing the scene on the sides.

artworks.title: Man Attending a Fire
artworks.description: The image shows a person tending a small fire. The composition features a low horizon separating the sky and earth. In the background, there is a hint of a distant hill or ridge with structures. The style is sketch-like with black lines defining the scene. The lines suggest movement, especially in the smoke and flame. The color scheme is mostly monochrome with earth tones around the fire, set against an off-white background.

artworks.title: Sun and Rain
artworks.description: The image features a close-up perspective looking towards the horizon in the distance. The horizon is visible across the middle of the composition, extending from left to right, with hilly landscapes and small structures sketched faintly in the distance. The brush technique resembles line drawing and etching, with distinct, fine lines used to create contours and textures, especially to depict clouds and rays of light. The overall color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black lines on a light background, which emphasizes the contrast and details within the image. Closest to us on the left side, there's a large, prominent cloud formation with vertical streaks that suggest rain or light, while the right side of the image features linear rays emanating from the sky, suggesting the presence of the sun.

artworks.title: The Two Crowns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crown above two hands holding a laurel wreath. The upper part of the image features a detailed crown with a face incorporated into its design, hovering in the sky. Below the crown, a pair of hands extends from the bottom center, delicately holding a laurel wreath. The landscape in the background is minimalistic, with sketch marks suggesting flowing garments or a hill, and a small structure is faintly outlined on a rocky formation off to the right. The style is reminiscent of early etchings where lines and shading create texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Nile Flooding
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, delicate structures on the horizon, a large tree on the right, lush foliage, and a body of water at the bottom. The drawing style is neat and precise with fine lines and monochromatic colors.

artworks.title: The Landing of the Troops
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 38.3 cm (5 1/2 × 15 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a scene with figures on land and sea from an elevated viewpoint. There are ships near the shore, soldiers marching on sandy terrain, and groups of people in the distance. The depiction is enclosed in a decorative cartouche with intricate line work. The color scheme is monochrome with black ink on a cream background.

artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 23.7 cm (5 1/8 × 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed, monochromatic engraving depicting a wide landscape with a high horizon showing hills and distant figures. Closest to the viewer are numerous figures in elaborate attire. The engraving features fine lines for textures and forms, with a black and white color palette against a pale backdrop. In the distance, there is a scene of crowded activity, possibly depicting historical or biblical events.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Sacred Cosmologia (Title with Astrologers)
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a gathering of figures in a natural setting. In the foreground, figures are around a large armillary sphere, with one holding a panel displaying a diagram and another holding a sign with Latin text. In the background, there is a distant landscape with a few figures and animals. Tall trees frame the scene, with intricate line work used to create texture and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly in shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the Miracles and Graces of Our Lady of "Bon-Secours-les-Nancy"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting an altar or shrine. The artwork features an ornate altar with a sculpture of a figure, adorned with flowing drapery and surrounded by an intricate architectural setting that includes arched ceilings and detailed stonework. The altar is flanked by candles and is elevated, with drapery above suggesting a place of worship. On either side of the altar, there are kneeling figures, each with a halo, appearing engaged in prayer or devotion. The scene is conveyed a sense of reverence and spiritual solemnity, with the Latin text inscribed below dedicated to "N-Dame de Bon Secours". The composition features a rich use of line work to create depth and texture within the architectural and religious elements of the scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white engraving depicting a historical or biblical scene. Several figures are shown in detail, including a central woman holding a small child with halos around their heads. A man kneels in front of them offering a gift, while two other men stand to the right holding offerings. A crowd of people and camels is visible in the background, along with buildings and clouds in the sky. A bright star shines above the scene.

artworks.title: The Homages of the Infant Saint John
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, featuring a seated woman at the center holding a baby on her lap. An older woman is seated to the left holding a child, while an elderly man stands to the right holding a staff. Two cherubic angels are behind the central woman, and a cherub above them is showering flowers. The background consists of intricately designed drapery.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure in the air above other figures on the ground. The central figure is rising into the sky with one arm holding a staff and the other extended upward. Their hair is flowing backwards, and they wear a draped garment. Rays of light surround them. Below, two figures stand with arms raised towards the central figure. They wear flowing robes and one holds a helmet. Armor is scattered on the ground around them. The background features swirling clouds and radiant lines.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial figure rising above a scene of individuals looking upward. The image depicts a luminous being ascending amidst clouds while holding a staff. Below, several figures in various dramatic poses look upwards. They appear expressive in their gestures, showing awe. The scene is rich in texture, with intricate line work conveying the folds of clothing and the billowing clouds.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.7 × 7.5 cm (4 3/16 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield with soldiers in armor and on horseback. A bright light shines from the sky, parting the clouds, and illuminating a figure on the ground. Soldiers and horses are in motion, some appearing off-balance or falling. The sky has intricate details showing the light's radiance, while the ground showcases the chaos below. The composition has a dynamic interplay of light and dark, emphasizing the intensity of the scene.
